summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/marketing-email-components@20.2.3 ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it to 0o755, and uses it via `execFileSync` to run a bundled 727KB single-line hex-obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js` at install time. The payload uses string-array rotation (`WV8StW`) and a large hex opcode table (`n7gIxM`) with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, and its behavior is opaque to Node-based static inspection. A React email-components package has no legitimate need for an alternate JS runtime or a sibling obfuscated bundle to be executed on `npm install`. The pattern matches the alternate-runtime-dropper shape: fetch a non-Node runtime from an unrelated source and use it to execute obfuscated bundled code, evading Node-oriented supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
